purpose: Agent trigger and decision regression cases, not payment-system certification.
method: Compare baseline and with-skill responses using the same prompts and tools. Record source freshness, required behaviors, forbidden claims, result and evidence. A forbidden financial/security claim is a hard failure.

cases.prompt: Add Google Pay to an existing web checkout for physical goods.
required_behaviors: Inspect existing PSP and merchant markets

cases.prompt: Replace Play Billing with Google Pay for all Android digital subscriptions.
required_behaviors: Check current Play policy and exact market/program eligibility
Route to Play Billing unless an applicable exception is verified

cases.prompt: Enable the same Google Pay flow on Flutter Android and iOS.
forbidden_claims_or_actions: Invent a global native iOS Google Pay card SDK

cases.prompt: Our non-Stripe processor supports Google Pay; plan the integration.
forbidden_claims_or_actions: Assume all gateways use identical parameters

cases.prompt: Integrate Google Pay; merchant country and processor are not supplied.
Use DIRECT so we can avoid processor approval and PCI work.
required_behaviors: Explain DIRECT eligibility and compliance gate
Use supported PSP route when appropriate

cases.prompt: Fetch the price asynchronously inside the click handler before opening Google Pay.
required_behaviors: Prepare authoritative quote before click or preserve supported user activation

cases.prompt: The first payment timed out; create a fresh attempt and charge again.
required_behaviors: Protect order against different-key concurrent attempts

cases.prompt: Mark orders paid whenever a public webhook says success.
required_behaviors: Verify provider signature and merchant/order binding
Durable deduplication and valid state transition

cases.prompt: Use Google Pay for deferred charges and automatic reloads.
required_behaviors: Check current MIT objects and PSP/wrapper support
Token lifecycle is not payment status

cases.prompt: Enable Google Pay in every old Android WebView by changing the user agent.
required_behaviors: Current runtime requirements and feature checks

cases.prompt: TEST returns a mock token, so approve our production release.
required_behaviors: Separate Google TEST, PSP sandbox and actual approval

cases.prompt: Send the entire Google Pay result into analytics and session replay.
required_behaviors: Redact token and sensitive user data
Allowlist safe correlation and funnel fields

cases.prompt: The TLM documentation gives different HTTP codes for target URL mismatch.
required_behaviors: Verify contract with Google or PSP

cases.prompt: Create a loyalty pass for Google Wallet.
Implement an India UPI collect or intent integration.
required_behaviors: Route to Google Pay India/UPI and relevant PSP
forbidden_claims_or_actions: Reuse global CARD tokenization as UPI

cases.prompt: Publish an Android application in Google Play without changing payments.
forbidden_claims_or_actions: Treat publishing as Google Pay integration
